name: chart

params.number: one big count-up number instead of bars
params.style: graph look, pick a DIFFERENT one per video (user 2026-11-11: graphs must not look alike across videos): number -> count (big count-up, the old default) | gauge (ring fills to number/max) | meter (horizontal track, `marks` [1, 5] ticks) | dots (100 dots, number lit: shares in %); bars -> bars (vertical, old default) | split (one bar cut into parts that add up, e.g. 20 reached / 80 lost)
params.max: gauge / meter full value (default 100 for gauge, the number itself for meter)

description: Animated graph from scene params in one of several looks (params.style); without params, an unlabelled decorative bar motif (never invented numbers)
